correctness.rationale: With exactly three marker ones an Abelian cube contains either zero ones or one in each of its three equal-length blocks. All-zero distinct factors are precisely 0^(3t) up to floor(max gap/3). Every three-one cube includes all marked ones and its literal content is uniquely specified by block length t and start s; the exact three inequalities on one positions yield lambda_t<=s<=upsilon_t and the sum in (1). Double counting by t,start,and one position in each block proves total sum (n-3t+1)t^3 and the rational generating-function term; inclusion-exclusion on four gaps gives the zero-only term. Uniform composition gaps converge to Dirichlet(1,1,1,1), the Lipschitz Riemann-sum limit is H(G), mean 1/270. The ordered uniform-three-point feasible region z<3y,3y-x<2 has volume 7/9 and therefore the zero atom is 2/9. Finite literal factor/continuum grid checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
